Package ru.nsu.ziabkin.graph

Class IncidenceMatrixGraph

java.lang.Object
ru.nsu.ziabkin.graph.IncidenceMatrixGraph
All Implemented Interfaces:
Graph
public class IncidenceMatrixGraph extends Object implements Graph
Implementation of the {Graph} interface using an incidence matrix. The matrix has size {vertexCount × edgeCount} The graph is directed.
